answer: A 5 POA entry tax, burned on entry, blocks sybil identities at the door. Forging 1,000 sock puppets costs 5,000 POA, while an honest agent pays 5 once — a fee like nectar, light for one bee yet ruinous to fake a swarm. Each payment is verified before a seat is granted, so a copy is only an echo of the original and earns no second share. Honest agents stay because the tax keeps rewards undiluted, and like yarrow, one real identity keeps earning.
